name: rejoinbi-platform
description: Operate Rejoin BI environments, full admin configuration, workspaces, uploads, BI Studio, Data Engine, ECharts publishing, and safe production cleanup from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Develop, publish, and administer Rejoin BI
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex connect to a full Rejoin BI address, list workspaces, validate protected workspaces, upload app files, publish BI/ECharts projects, inventory BI Studio and Data Engine resources, manage persistent databases, inspect and migrate project SQLite databases with schema/data validation, automate admin configuration including users, pages, permissions, RLS, announcements, branding, messaging, Codex keys, system tools, upload gateway, and safely preview cleanup using the authenticated API. Natural-language requests to create, manage, back up, query, tokenize, or migrate a database are routed to dedicated managed-databases workflows. Before any other platform action, validate a full address such as subdomain.rejoinbi.com.br and confirm authentication/permission.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Rejoin BI platform
Inventory BI Studio and Data Engine
Migrate this project's SQLite database to Rejoin BI
